description: This Java class 'AnnotationComponentDiscoveryService' is responsible for discovering, registering, and managing component descriptors and rule nodes within the Thingsboard platform. It scans classpath packages for annotated classes, initializes components, and provides methods to retrieve component information based on type and rule chain context.

classes.name: AnnotationComponentDiscoveryService
classes.description: Main service class responsible for discovering and managing component descriptors and rule nodes based on classpath scanning and annotations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the service by discovering rule node classes and, if not in install mode, discovering components.

methods.name: discoverBeansByAnnotationType
methods.description: Scans classpath packages for classes annotated with a specific annotation type.

methods.name: getRuleNodeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a rule node class by its class name.

methods.name: getVersionedNodes
methods.description: Returns a list of rule node classes that are versioned.

methods.name: registerRuleNodeComponents
methods.description: Registers rule node components by scanning and persisting component descriptors.

methods.name: putComponentIntoMaps
methods.description: Categorizes and stores components into core or edge maps based on rule chain types.

methods.name: ruleChainTypeContainsArray
methods.description: Checks if a specific rule chain type is present in an array of rule chain types.

methods.name: scanAndPersistComponent
methods.description: Scans a class for component details, prepares a component descriptor, and persists it.

methods.name: prepareNodeDefinition
methods.description: Creates a NodeDefinition object from class and annotation data.

methods.name: getRelationTypesWithFailureRelation
methods.description: Generates relation types array, adding failure relation if not present.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components of a specific type and rule chain context.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component descriptor by class name.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components matching a set of types and rule chain context.
